documents.title: Cultivated Chicken and Halal Market Access
documents.description: An approximately 11,900-word paper separating donor procurement, culture inputs, transformation, edibility, certification and food authorization. Three figures and five appendices retain source qualifications and open questions. Agent source and coverage checks completed; human scholarly review remains pending.

documents.title: Protein Consumption and Alternative Protein Adoption in India and Pakistan
documents.description: Comparative secondary synthesis of the affordability, dietary practice, legitimacy, certification, and policy conditions that shape adoption. Proposes the comparative tests and forecast-question requirements that would follow.

documents.title: Cultivated Chicken in the Focal Countries: Where the Evidence Stands
documents.description: The October continuation of the Phase One review: the current answer for India, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and the UAE, a gate table across six founder-cell profiles, labelled search leads and inferences, and questions for mentors. No claim has had human scholarly review.

documents.title: Cultivated Chicken: Religious Conditions and Market Access
documents.description: A public-source review covering 45 school questions, seven countries and four historical comparisons, with 74 claims, explicit uncertainties and a Phase Two handoff. Religious positions, certification and market authorization remain distinct.

documents.title: Alternative Meat Survey Data
documents.description: Structured extraction from nine Muslim-country and Southeast Asian survey studies and reports, with 29 retained findings, source links and sample caveats. Measures remain separated as willingness, preference, awareness, consumption, sample composition or qualitative findings.

documents.title: Protein Transitions Across Unequal Food Systems
documents.description: Protein supply, consumer adoption, public research and talent policy, and institutional capabilities. Includes country data, charts, locators, and a cited-passage ledger.

documents.title: AI and the Protein Transition
documents.description: Evidence connecting technical progress, adoption, displacement, animal outcomes, and policy under uncertainty. Includes an annotated library and RIS bibliography.

documents.title: Policy Evidence to Decision Table
documents.description: Six conditional policy choices, the evidence relevant to each, and reasons to revise them. These proposals have not been evaluated or adopted.

documents.title: Alt-Protein and Food-Systems Orientation
documents.description: Technology, capital, talent, regulation, and foresight practice, with source links preserved from the original briefing.

documents.title: Alt Protein Without the Jargon
documents.description: An introduction to the production tracks, value chain, market definitions, and technical vocabulary, with private project instructions removed.
